summary: Iteration 17: tested ANFGC listing + featured picks, link updates (YWCA/Job Junction/HRM), Google Sheet import + hourly cron, homepage Community picks strip (desktop + mobile 390), Admin sheet-import panel, dashboard 'Share your win' dialog, plus regression of /community, /events, /jobs and the dashboard cards. Backend: 26/26 pass. One iteration-16 test was stale (expected 15 listings, there are now 16) and I updated it. Frontend: every requested flow works and there were no page errors or error overlays. One security issue found in the sheet import: an admin-only SSRF.

minor.issue: SSRF (admin-only): the regex is not anchored to the host, and the '/d/e/' (publish-to-web) branch reuses the original URL. Confirmed: sheet_url 'http://127.0.0.1:8001/docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/abc' made the backend fetch http://127.0.0.1:8001/.../pub?output=csv (seen in backend log). Fix: parse the URL and require scheme https and netloc == 'docs.google.com', then rebuild the URL from the parsed ID. Also set follow_redirects to only follow redirects to google hosts.

Duplicates are detected only by slug against existing listings. DELETE /api/listings/{id} is a hard delete, so a spam or rejected submission the admin deletes is imported again as pending on the next hourly run. Fix: keep a record of imported row keys (e.g. a hash of timestamp + name in settings or a separate collection) or soft-delete with status 'rejected'.

issues: 2 of the 5 featured picks are placeholders ('Example: North End Barber Studio', 'Example: Portrait & Grad Photographer') shown prominently on the homepage. Consider unfeaturing them now that real listings exist.
Desktop: the 5 cards of w-56 leave empty space on the right of the container (minor).
Black style: the employer line in #0055A4 on #111 has low contrast; use the accent yellow or a lighter blue.
Footer tagline at 26px reaches almost the full 1080px width and may clip with longer text.
A very long job title can push the headline past the white card. The description y is clamped to 700, but the headline itself is not.
Download filename has a trailing dash (hired-library-page-student-shelver-.png). Trim dashes.
The canvas uses 'Space Grotesk', which may not be loaded when drawing; the output looks like Arial. Await document.fonts.load before rendering.

action_items: Fix the SSRF in _sheet_csv_url: strictly validate host == docs.google.com over https and build the fetch URL from the parsed ID.
Stop deleted or rejected submissions from being imported again on each hourly run.
Optional: unfeature the 'Example:' placeholder listings so they don't appear in the homepage strip.
Optional polish on the share card: contrast in the black style, long-title overflow, filename trailing dash, font loading.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _sheet_csv_url: re.search without host anchoring, and the publish-to-web branch returns the user URL as-is (SSRF).
_do_sheet_import: one find_one per row (N+1) is fine for small sheets. Name-only slug dedupe means two different businesses with the same name collide (the second is skipped silently).
SheetImportPanel always sends save:true, so a failed attempt does not save (good). There is no UI to clear the saved sheet even though DELETE /admin/listings/import-settings exists.
server.py is 1689 lines. Consider moving listings/import into a router module.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: ANFGC (anfgc-halifax) is featured; 5 featured, 16 approved listings. Event feeds include ywcahalifax.com/events and jobjunction workshop-information. HRM jobs and the job feed use halifax.ca/about-halifax/employment. Import endpoints return 400s with friendly messages, 403 for non-admin and 401 for anon. Cron returns 401 without auth or with a wrong token, and 200 {accepted:true, skipped:'no sheet configured'} with the secret. Homepage strip sits between /02 Featured and /03 Spotlight; card testids use the slug, e.g. community-pick-anfgc-halifax, and link to /community/{id}. Mobile: no page overflow and the strip scrolls. Admin tab testid is admin-tab-community. The dashboard status select is native, select[data-testid=job-status-{job_id}]. If the SSRF fix lands, retest with http://127.0.0.1:8001/docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/abc (save:false): it should return 400 'Paste a Google Sheets link' and make no outbound fetch.
